title: DO-IRP: some minor changes
description:
- Remove a couple of #includes that are already available
- Make some value_strings and true_false_strings static
- Use fixed mask widths for readability
- Use DO_IRP_TCP_PORT (note that IANA refers to old name hdl-srv)

notes.body: @m2martin - do these changes look ok to you?

Hi Martin,

yes, there are no dissection-relevant changes except `DO_IRP_TCP_PORT` - that was a mistake - thank you for that.
So, from my side, go for it.

The IANA assignment is correct. Handle Service is the old (original RFC) name for DO-IRP.\
Because of that, you may remove the comment for that.
Thanks, I amended the comment to note that it is the earlier name.
